'''Jan Hailbrock''' was an [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] who operated in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He supplied a number of [[Tapani Noble Houses|nobles]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] with illegal weapons and exotic items, and as such they encouraged customs officials on the planet to overlook his activity. Since Hailbrock kept a low profile, most officials were happy to leave him alone. He sympathized with the Alliance during the war and provided Rebel cells in the Tapani [[Sector/Legends|sector]] with weaponry and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] at great personal risk, as if his ties to the Alliance were revealed his career would have quickly been over.<ref name="LotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jan Hailbrock first appeared as a possible ally for Rebel heroes in the campaign guide included in ''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'', a [[1997]] supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]]. The supplement was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Chris Doyle]], and did not clarify Hailbrock's [[Species/Legends|species]].
